profile.headline: Scientific Software Developer @ Stellar Science Ltd Co | Physics PhD
profile.summary:
As a Postdoctoral Fellow at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center since 2022, contributed to the BurstCube mission by bridging science analysis and engineering teams. Enabled gamma-ray detection through tools for integration, testing, and flight operations, while advancing pipeline development, including multivariate trigger classification and sub-threshold searches. Supported Fermi Gamma-ray Burst Monitor operations as a Burst Advocate.  

With over seven years of expertise in astrophysics and high-energy physics, developed a robust foundation in data analytics, mission operations, and automation. Previous work at CERN involved machine learning for dark matter searches and hardware trigger system maintenance. Dedicated to advancing scientific discovery through collaborative problem-solving and innovative software solutions.

positions.description:
- Deputy Operations Lead for the BurstCube mission
- Consolidated efforts between the science analysis and engineering teams
- Pipeline development necessary for science analysis, including multivariate trigger classification and sub-threshold searches for GRB counterparts to gravitational waves
- Burst Advocate for the Fermi Gamma-ray Space Telescope's Gamma-ray Burst Monitor (GBM)
- Designed software tools for use during multiple phases of BurstCube's life cycle, particularly for integration & testing and flight operations
